title: BS Ancient Settings
description: These options are written to bs_ancient_config.cfg. Changes require restarting the game and starting a new run to take effect.
sections.ancients.title: Ancients
sections.events.title: Events
sections.fairyTales.title: Fairy Tales
sections.fairyTales.description: Fairy Tale Mode includes many severely detrimental relics that may greatly alter your run. We recommend leaving it disabled for your first playthrough.
sections.fairyTaleAllowList.title: Strongly Negative Fairy Tales, Myths, and News
sections.fairyTaleAllowList.description: The following Fairy Tales, Myths, and News relics do not appear by default and must be enabled individually. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
onlyUseModAncients.title: Only Spawn Mod Ancients
onlyUseModAncients.description: When enabled, Act 2 will only choose from enabled Node/Mabel/Lorina, and Act 3 will only choose from enabled Prickett/Mabel. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
disableModAncients.title: Disable Mod Map Ancients
disableModAncients.description: When enabled, Node, Prickett, Mabel, and Lorina will not appear on the map. This takes priority over "Only Spawn Mod Ancients". Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
enableNodeAncient.title: Allow Node
enableNodeAncient.description: When disabled, Node will not appear at Ancient nodes in Act 2. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
enablePrickettAncient.title: Allow Prickett
enablePrickettAncient.description: When disabled, Prickett will not appear at Ancient nodes in Act 3. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
enableMabelAncient.title: Allow Mabel
enableMabelAncient.description: When disabled, Mabel will not appear at Ancient nodes in Acts 2 or 3. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
enableLorinaAncient.title: Allow Lorina
enableLorinaAncient.description: When disabled, Lorina will not appear at Ancient nodes in Act 2. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
replaceNeowAppearance.title: Replace Neow Appearance
replaceNeowAppearance.description: When enabled, replaces starting Neow's appearance, name, title, and related dialogue with Grand Guignol. Requires restarting the game.
grandGuignolInitialRelicChance.title: Grand Guignol Initial Relic Chance
grandGuignolInitialRelicChance.descripti: Controls the chance for a starting positive option to be replaced by Grand Guignol's initial relic. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
enableModEvents.title: Enable Mod Events
enableModEvents.description: When enabled, BS Ancient events can appear in the normal event pool. When disabled, these events will not appear naturally. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
disableTestingEvents.title: Disable Testing Events
disableTestingEvents.description: When enabled, testing events related to SAN and hand mirrors, such as Clown and Girl in the Maze, will not appear naturally. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
enableFairyTaleMode.title: Fairy Tale Mode
enableFairyTaleMode.description: When enabled, you gain a random Fairy Tale relic every 4 combat victories, including Boss combats. The same Fairy Tale cannot be gained twice in one run. Not recommended for multiplayer. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
enablePositiveFairyTaleRelics.title: Allow Positive Fairy Tales
enablePositiveFairyTaleRelics.descriptio: When disabled, Fairy Tale Mode will not randomly grant positive Fairy Tale relics. This takes priority over other individual Fairy Tale relic toggles. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
enableNegativeFairyTaleRelics.title: Allow Negative Fairy Tales
enableNegativeFairyTaleRelics.descriptio: When disabled, Fairy Tale Mode will not randomly grant negative, destructive Fairy Tale, Myth, or News relics. This takes priority over other individual relic toggles. Requires restarting the game and starting a new run.
